description: forest-like 1D field, lognormal (Bi-Davidsen-like) density, sigma_g=0.8, linear velocities, NO shell crossing; seed 1, 20 Mpc/h, 2048 px, 2048 particles (h=2.5 local spacings), T=1e4 Delta^0.6, n_HI ~ Delta^2 T^-0.7, <F> tuned to 0.68

notes.T_v: HI-column-weighted per pixel; v physical km/s, + = away from observer.
